# Vehicles

Make a monster carry its army on land or through the air, as vanilla ships do at sea. Give it a deck to fight on in battle, and let its owner recruit wherever it stands.

These go after `newmonster` or `selectmonster`, beside vanilla `transport`, which sets how many size 1 units the monster carries. Carrying an army and recruiting from a vehicle work for human players only (for now): AI players and independents move and recruit as in vanilla. `copystats` and `clearspec` affect these.

!!! info "More in the CoE5 manual"
    Vanilla ships are in Illwinter's official modding manual, under ["Monster Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=14).

### transportland <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #transportland .command data-toc-label="transportland" data-added="3.6" }

Makes the monster carry its army on land, as a ship does at sea. The army moves where the monster can and on its action points, as long as every unit carried is size 1 and they are no more than its `transport` value. Carried units start their next turn with full action points. Needs `transport`.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@transportland
    ```

    Or off, on a monster that has it:

    ```c5m
    #!@transportland 0
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    transportland
    ```

    Or off, on a monster that has it:

    ```c5se
    transportland 0
    ```

### transportair <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #transportair .command data-toc-label="transportair" data-added="3.6" }

Like `transportland`, in the Sky and over water. With `transportland` too, a flying monster takes its army from land over water and into the Sky. Carried units stay in the Sky while a carrier that flies and floats lives. Without one they fall as in vanilla, and over water they drown at the month's end.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@transportair
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    transportair
    ```

### transportmap "&lt;.coem&gt;" <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #transportmap .command data-toc-label="transportmap" data-added="3.6" }

Gives the monster a deck in battle, as a vanilla ship has at sea. Each one places the map's objects in front of its side, and the side's units board them. On a monster with vanilla `ship` the line does nothing, since vanilla gives it a ship's deck<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = NO --> (logged in `coe5mod.log`)<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = YES -->.

- **.coem:** A battle map file in your mod's folder, in double quotes.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@transportmap "orc_camp.coem"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    transportmap "orc_camp.coem"
    ```

### transportheart "&lt;monster&gt;" <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #transportheart .command data-toc-label="transportheart" data-added="3.6" }

Names the deck's object the monster is lost with, as a ship sinks with its hull. The monster stays off the field, as a ship does, and is also lost when its side loses. Needs `transportmap`.

- **monster:** An object of the deck's map, in double quotes, or its number.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@transportheart "Palisade Parapet"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    transportheart "Palisade Parapet"
    ```

### transportterrain "&lt;terrain&gt;" <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #transportterrain .command data-toc-label="transportterrain" data-added="3.6" }

Lets the monster's owner recruit on its square as if it held a citadel of that terrain: that terrain's recruitment offers, once a month for each vehicle.

- **terrain:** A terrain in double quotes, or its number.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@transportterrain "Fortified Hoburg"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    transportterrain "Fortified Hoburg"
    ```

### Example vehicles { #example }

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newmonster "Mumak"
    copystats "War Elephant"
    copyspr "War Elephant"
    transport 4
    #!@transportland

    newmonster "Great Eagle"
    copystats "Roc"
    copyspr "Roc"
    transport 2
    #!@transportair
    #!@transportland
    float
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newmonster "Mumak"
    copystats "War Elephant"
    copyspr "War Elephant"
    transport 4
    transportland

    newmonster "Great Eagle"
    copystats "Roc"
    copyspr "Roc"
    transport 2
    transportair
    transportland
    float
    ```
